note.after_visit_summary: You have coronary artery disease with a stent that is stable. Your LDL cholesterol is high at 118, and we want it under 55. You stopped atorvastatin due to leg aches, which have improved. We are starting rosuvastatin 5 mg once daily and ezetimibe 10 mg once daily to lower your cholesterol. If leg aches return, stop rosuvastatin and message us, but keep taking ezetimibe. Continue aspirin 81 mg daily, clopidogrel 75 mg daily, and metoprolol 25 mg daily. Do not stop clopidogrel without talking to us first. Keep walking regularly. We will recheck your cholesterol and liver tests in 8 weeks. Follow up in 3 months.
